scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C web build && cargo clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm -C web build && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.dev:server: pnpm -C web build && PORT=${ICONS_PORT:-3000} cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
